item.title: Better names Barry Feierstein as new COO
item.description: Feierstein brings more than 30 years of experience and most recently served as chief operating officer at Hamilton Insurance Agency.

item.title: Top agent Heather Domi rejoins Douglas Elliman in Manhattan
item.description: After seven years at Compass, Douglas Elliman welcomes back Heather Domi, whose team closed seven deals totaling $30 million in 2024.

item.title: Reverse mortgage vet says an end to HUD counseling risks senior protections
item.description: A proposal to remove HUD-required counseling for reverse mortgages could strip key senior protections, warns NatEquity CEO Peter Mazonas.

item.title: CertifID’s Tyler Adams on deepfakes, fraud and protecting homebuyers
item.description: Fraudsters are combining AI with patience, timing and realism to exploit real estate transactions in increasingly convincing ways.

item.title: Keller Williams sharpens focus on agent teams for 2026
item.description: Keller Williams is rolling out updated training, mastermind groups and leadership to support agent teams in 2026.

item.title: Sonic Fire Tech launches infrasound wildfire defense system in California
item.description: Sonic Fire Tech has launched a wildfire defense system using infrasound to extinguish fires without water or chemicals. The system detects embers up to 1,500 yards away and aims to reduce property damage and water use in California.

item.title: TD Bank expresses cautious optimism for affordable housing in 2026
item.description: A TD Bank survey shows that half of affordable housing professionals believe market challenges will affect their deal pipelines next year.

item.title: Spanberger unveils Virginia housing affordability plan
item.description: Virginia Gov.-elect Abigail Spanberger (D) focused on improving affordability during her campaign. To follow through, she rolled out a housing agenda that leans heavily on preservation of existing affordable homes, empowering localities to add more, and rebuilding state-level tools.

item.title: AOL provider Voxtur files for Chapter 15 bankruptcy
item.description: Voxtur filed for Chapter 15 bankruptcy in Delaware, citing $77.7 million in liabilities and ongoing litigation.

item.title: Existing home sales hit 9-month high with inventory at 1.43M units
item.description: Existing home sales rose for the third consecutive month, reaching a nine-month high as mortgage rates fell and inventory hit 1.43 million.
